summary: Create Application fields: Name, optional URL (Technology Preview nav link), Description, Organization, Authorization grant type, Client Type and space-separated Redirect URIs (required for Authorization code). The Client ID and Client Secret are shown once; a secret exists only for Confidential clients.
questions: What fields are required to create an OAuth application?
Why is there no client secret for my OAuth application?
Can I see the client secret again later?

answer_card.title: Create an OAuth application
answer_card.answer_md:
1. **Access Management > OAuth Applications > Create OAuth application**.
2. Set **Name**, **Organization**, **Authorization grant type** and **Client type** (required). Add **Redirect URIs** (space-separated) for *Authorization code*.
3. Click **Create OAuth application** and copy the **Client ID** and **Client Secret** now; the secret is shown only once and only exists for *Confidential* clients.
